title: DhanamRawCustomer
description: Contract schema for the Dhanam federation endpoint response. This is the shape returned by GET /v1/customers/:externalId and consumed by PhyneCRM's DhanamProvider. Both sides MUST validate against this schema. Any breaking change requires updating this file and both contract tests.

id.description: Dhanam user ID (maps to PhyneCRM's externalId)

plan.description: Subscription tier name (e.g. community, pro, enterprise)

amount.description: Outstanding balance amount (0 when no pending payments)

invoices.description: Recent billing events mapped to invoice format (max 20, newest first)

amount.description: Invoice amount in the specified currency

status.description: Invoice payment status (mapped from billing event status)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the billing event was created

paid_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of payment, or null if unpaid. For succeeded events, falls back to created_at if metadata.paidAt is absent.

payment_methods.description: Payment method references (provider-level, no raw card data)

id.description: Provider customer ID (e.g. cus_xxx for Stripe, ctm_xxx for Paddle)

type.description: Billing provider type (stripe, paddle, janua, etc.)

last_four.description: Last four digits of payment method or masked value (****)

is_default.description: Whether this is the active/default payment method
